items.title: Tigers waste no time ahead of daunting Proteas challenge
items.summary: With limited time to acclimatise to the conditions, Bangladesh have wasted no time getting down to business. Following Thursday's session, the visitors have two more practice sessions scheduled before taking on the Proteas in their maiden Test at the iconic Wanderers Stadium.

items.title: 'Toughest Bangladesh team we'll face': Harmer expects stern Tigers test
items.summary: As the hype builds ahead of Sunday’s first Test, a second contingent of Bangladesh players and officials touched down in Johannesburg early Thursday morning and immediately hit the nets. Waiting for them is a South African side expecting a fierce contest.

items.title: Bangladesh pace attack no more a 'pop gun', says South Africa coach
items.summary: “Bangladesh have got a fast-building attack now. Whereas in years gone by, they'd come here with like a pop-gun attack, now they've got guys that can mix it,” Conrad said.

items.title: Four wickets for six runs: Batting crumbles as Tigresses lose to Pakistan in Emerging Nations opener
items.summary: Bangladesh women's team began their Emerging Nations Trophy campaign on a disappointing note, suffering an eight-wicket defeat to Pakistan in Ajman, UAE, on Thursday.

items.title: Rizwanullah, openers set up big win as Pakistan make U-19 Asia Cup final
items.summary: Rizwanullah's five-for restricted Bangladesh to 138 following which Usman Khan and Hayam Khan mowed down the target with ease

items.title: Pakistan too strong for Bangladesh in U-19 Asia Cup semis
items.summary: Usman remained unbeaten on 64 off 54 balls, while Hayam struck 69 off 72 as Pakistan raced to 141 for one in just 21.5 overs to book their place in the final.

items.title: ‘What do we currently have for women’s cricket?’
items.summary: Veteran coach Sarwar Imran spoke to The Daily Star's Samsul Arefin Khan about his experience, regrets and concerns over the state of women's cricket in Bangladesh.

items.title: Shanto: Bangladesh failed to make use of home conditions
items.summary: "Looking at the Test match as a whole, neither our batters nor our bowlers performed well; the responsibility lies with us"

items.title: Laurie Evans: 'My world was turned upside-down' during four-year fight against doping ban
items.summary: Batter experienced 'suicidal thoughts' after testing positive for ostarine during routine test in 2022

items.title: Dale Benkenstein appointed Bangladesh's batting specialist ahead of SA tour
items.summary: Bangladesh are scheduled to tour South Africa in November and December 2026 to play two Tests, three ODIs and three T20Is

items.title: Chase: Our improved game against spin helped us win in Bangladesh
items.summary: "We did not lose a series [this year]. This is something that hasn't been done for a number of years"

items.title: Hridoy ensures draw in Sylhet; WI beat Bangladesh 1-0 in series
items.summary: Hridoy scored 324 runs in the Test, across both innings, while Warrican claimed a four-for and a three-wicket haul

items.title: Mushfiqur becomes first Bangladesh batter to score 7000 runs in Tests
items.summary: Apart from being Bangladesh's highest run-getter in Tests, Mushfiqur Rahim is also their most-capped Test cricketer and holds their record for most Test centuries

items.title: Bangladesh call up uncapped batter Mahfijul Islam for Tests in South Africa
items.summary: Mohammad Naim and Khaled Ahmed have been brought into the squad for the two-Test series in South Africa in place of Soumya Sarkar and Nayeem Hasan

items.title: Hridoy on his 242*: You 'cannot get out of a difficult spot without counterattacking'
items.summary: Record-breaker also offered praise for the Bangladesh lower-order for the recovery from 184 for 7 to 386 in the first innings against West Indies in Sylhet

items.title: Kavem Hodge: There is a belief and shared mindset among WI batters
items.summary: Kavem Hodge scored his third Test century in Sylhet and ascribed his team's collective rise in batting form as down to belief and camaraderie within the set-up

items.title: Hridoy's historic 242* powers Bangladesh's epic turnaround in Sylhet
items.summary: Bangladesh went from 184 for 7 to 386 despite Shadman not batting, thus gaining a lead of 30 against WI
